test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect narration of the following statement from the given alternatives:

The king said to his wife, "I have already conquered all the neighbouring kingdoms and possess all the wealth therein."

options.text: The king told his wife that he had already conquered all the neighbouring kingdoms and possessed all the wealth therein.
The king told his wife that he has already conquered all the neighbouring kingdoms and possessed all the wealth therein.
The king told his wife that he had already conquered all the neighbouring kingdoms and possesses all the wealth therein.
The king told his wife that he has already conquered all the neighbouring kingdoms and possesses all the wealth therein.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reporting Verb:** "Said to" changes to **"told"** in indirect speech because it is followed by an object ("his wife").
 
• **Conjunction:** The comma and inverted commas are replaced by the conjunction **"that"**.
 
• **Pronoun Change:** The first-person pronoun **"I"** (referring to the king) changes to the third-person **"he"**.
 
• **Tense Change:** Since the reporting verb is in the past ("told"), the verbs in the reported speech must shift back: 
 
 
• Present Perfect **"have already conquered"** changes to Past Perfect **"had already conquered"**.
 
• Present Simple **"possess"** changes to Past Simple **"possessed"**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The king told his wife that he had already conquered all the neighbouring kingdoms and possessed all the wealth therein."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect because it fails to change **"has"** (which should be "had") to the past perfect, even though it correctly changed "possessed".
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect because it fails to change **"possesses"** to the past tense ("possessed").
 
• **Option 4:** Incorrect because it retains the present tense for both verbs (**"has"** and **"possesses"**), which is grammatically incorrect when the reporting verb is in the past.
